snippet.title: Jonathan's Adventure Pricker Edition - 2.0 Update Trailer
snippet.description:
The chronological first game in the Jonathan's Adventure series, Jonathan's Adventure Pricker Edition, is getting a new update! New events, new (old) characters, and new lore, the game is going to be better than ever before. Coming on April 1st to celebrate the 4 year anniversary of Jonathan's Adventure 2's release!
